name: Netcalibre Ltd
notes:
We provide Internet Access (FTTC/FTTP, leased lines) and Hosting services (Shared/Dedicated/Colocation/'Cloud') and so have a mix of eyeball and content traffic, though we are starting to skew towards mostly inbound due to the much faster rate of growth of eyeball traffic.

Prefix counts are suggested max-prefixes when peering with us due to how our AS-SET expands, though ordinarily we will advertise far fewer prefixes.

We provide clue-hands & infrastructure build services, spares management, to order and on demand optics etc with SLA on contract or on demand to most London Docklands and central London sites. Contact sales for details.
